properties.label: Eight-by-eight matrix and detail panel
properties.text: Balance an eight-by-eight labelled decision matrix with one stable detail-reading panel.

properties.label: Orthogonal matrix labels
properties.text: Set column labels vertically, row labels horizontally and the detail explanation in a calm readable measure.

properties.label: Blue and red matrix signals
properties.text: Use blue-black, very thin square cells, small blue positive marks, muted red tension marks and one exact bright focus outline.

properties.label: Three-state pairing marks
properties.text: Distinguish documented pairings, combinations needing deliberate reconciliation and unassessed pairs with three clearly different marks.

properties.label: Equivalent matrix inspection
properties.text: Make hover, focus and tap reveal the same named pairing detail; use roving arrow-key focus inside the matrix and keep those keys from driving the page carousel.

properties.label: Unknown pairing discipline
properties.text: Treat unassessed as unknown rather than impossible, and never infer a universal aesthetic prohibition from zero co-occurrence in a small archive.

properties.label: Visible matrix context acceptance
properties.text: Keep labels, the focused cell and its explanation visible together at mobile width, and give every cell an accessible name.
